title: SavedTopicsLoad::Started is a bare in-flight stage; answers settle by RequestPurpose::LoadSavedMessagesTopics, not a RequestId
trigger: open Saved Messages while a sublist page is in flight, then a second window/pump asks again
effect: dedupe and the 404/error arm settle by purpose, so another request with that purpose ends the stage
fix: SavedTopicsLoad::Loading { request: RequestId } settled in connect/forum_saved.rs and threads/error.rs by id

title: SearchPaging::Loading is a bare in-flight stage next to SearchState::generation; a page answer is matched by search generation, not a RequestId
trigger: scroll the global search list, change filter, scroll again
effect: the next-page ask holds no request, so an answer is trusted through the generation counter only

title: Leg::Pending is a bare in-flight stage for three search legs, matched by search_generation; only Paying carries a RequestId
trigger: type a query, retype while legs are out
effect: answers matched by a counter in PendingRequest instead of the request held in the stage

title: fourteen parallel per-supergroup maps (restrict/invite/promote/manage_tags/manage_topics/change_info/send_welcome rights, join_by_request, is_broadcast, sign_messages, show_message_sender, anti_spam, can_toggle_anti_spam) written together in two copies of the same block and never removed together
trigger: updateSupergroup applies; the chat is deleted or the user leaves
effect: rights of a gone supergroup stay in every map; the two near-identical write blocks (apply_update_supergroup, apply_supergroup) can drift
fix: one SupergroupFacts struct per supergroup id, replaced whole

title: Audience<T>::Loading and ::Paging are bare in-flight stages for five lists; answers are matched by (chat, message[, filter]) from the purpose, never by a RequestId
trigger: open the Seen/Reacted dialog on a message, close it, reopen on the same message, switch reaction tabs while a page is out
effect: an answer of an older ask for the same message settles the newer ask; fail_audience(purpose) fails whichever ask is current

title: SetChangeStage::Working(SetChange) holds the kind of change but no RequestId; finish_set_change settles by set_id + change kind
trigger: Add then Archive of the same set in the sticker set box while the first request is out
effect: the first answer, if it names the same kind, ends the stage for the second request; guarded today only by the box disabling its buttons

title: ReplyTarget::Loading holds its RequestId but accept_replied_message / reject_replied_message settle by (chat, message) from the purpose, never comparing it
trigger: getRepliedMessage fails with a passing error, Retry elapses, the row is asked again (new request), then the first request's late answer or error lands
effect: the older request's answer or error overwrites the newer Loading stage (a late error bumps attempts and can flip to Missing while the newer ask is still out)
fix: apply/error arms compare ReplyTarget::Loading{request} with pending.id before writing

title: PendingRequest carries a bag of optional correlation fields (scope, forum_topic_id, user_id, supergroup_id, community_id, story_id, story_ids, story_album_id, user_ids, around_message_id, window_epoch) whose meaning depends on the purpose and is kept in step by the request_for_* helpers
trigger: any answer whose handler reads a field its builder did not set (for example around_message_id read as GetHistory's from_message_id and as GetGameHighScores' message)
effect: a handler that forgets the purpose check reads None or another request's meaning; the apply arms silently skip
fix: the correlation data lives inside RequestPurpose variants (purpose-specific payload) instead of side Options

title: ChatSearchJump::Loading { message_id, then } names the target but holds no RequestId; finish_history_around matches the answer by message id (jump_serial is a second hand-bumped counter beside the stage)
trigger: jump to a message, jump to another, jump back to the first while the first around-page is still out
effect: the first request's answer (same message id) settles the second jump, or lands as stale; no way to tell the asks apart

title: take_sponsored_views marks ads viewed before viewMessages goes out; only a failed send untakes them, a TDLib error answer or a swept request leaves them marked
trigger: an ad shows while the connection is flaky or TDLib answers the viewMessages with an error (flood wait, 500) or the request is swept stale
effect: the ad stays in ChatSponsoredMessages::viewed, never sent again until the list is refetched after five minutes and dropped; the impression is not counted
fix: viewed ids held in a stage keyed by the ViewSponsoredMessages RequestId, released on error and lost-request settlement (no arm for RequestPurpose::ViewSponsoredMessages exists in the error or lost-request paths)

title: MessagesState::sponsored_hidden is a session-long bool set from three places (ok of toggleHasSponsoredMessagesEnabled, report result AdsHidden, UI) and never cleared
trigger: hide ads as Premium, later lose Premium or turn ads back on elsewhere, or log out and in within one Session
effect: ads stay hidden and unfetched for the Session's life regardless of the account's setting
fix: derive from the account's has_sponsored_messages_enabled option instead of a local latch
